features: Live radio, podcasts and LibriVox audiobooks from OndaCast in one calm player
My Media: favorite stations, your shows, audiobooks, playlists and history, filtered by kind
Podcast categories (True Crime, Comedy, News, Sports and more) and episodes sorted and filtered your way
Up next fills itself from the show or new episodes you play, always behind your own picks
Per-show skip intro and outro and speed, playlists, repeat one or all, shuffle
Resume anywhere, chapter progress, bookmarks with notes, sleep timer and keyboard shortcuts
requirements: A Tend panel that provides the ondacast capability
TEND Notes installed with a notebook, to save clips (optional)
release_notes: 1.4.1: The seek bar now stays in step with the audio. Episodes longer than their listed length (inserted ads) no longer show 0:00 left while still playing, and audiobook chapters line up with their real lengths. Includes 1.4.0: Up next fills itself from the show you play, and podcast categories.
